scripts.build:moon: cd .. && moon build bench/backend/entry --release --target wasm && moon build bench/backend/entry --release --target wasm-gc && moon build bench/backend/entry --release --target js && npm --prefix bench run opt
scripts.maplibre: node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --uncapped && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --throttle=4 && node maplibre/run.mjs --runs=5 --throttle=4 --uncapped
scripts.opt: mkdir -p dist && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-bulk-memory-opt --enable-sign-ext --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-mutable-globals --enable-multivalue --enable-reference-types --enable-simd ../_build/wasm/release/build/bench/backend/entry/entry.wasm -o dist/entry.wasm-opt.wasm && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-bulk-memory-opt --enable-sign-ext --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-mutable-globals --enable-multivalue --enable-reference-types --enable-simd --enable-gc ../_build/wasm-gc/release/build/bench/backend/entry/entry.wasm -o dist/entry.wasm-gc-opt.wasm
